limitations: Static/interface review is not a real GPU execution or numerical repeatability claim
training_config_path and SHA are passed for provenance but worker uses frozen source constants rather than reading that config; root must write consistent config
4096MiB update admission is a conservative first actual task requirement, not an observed backward peak; root must inspect actual training peak
D0 is intentionally resident between batches; every new sample/update admission observes current free VRAM including it
read_only_scope: Controller/service/worker source and training/math registration only; no blind reviews or image mapping read

corrected_previous_findings: D0 existing unlaunched job gets fresh admission
Every actual update gets fresh admission
Math-tested source SHA checked at controller start and before every actual update
recovery.graceful_controller_exit: EOF releases resident owned D0; 30-second close timeout reports PID without killing unrelated processes
recovery.incomplete: Worker/service rejects existing attempts or partial ledger/proposals; no automatic replay
recovery.resident_failure: ERROR then service exit1; controller raises; atexit closes owned stdin
